item.title: 9 Area Schools aiming for State Tourney Berths
item.description: It is playoff time for the area high school basketball programs and while none have qualified for state, nine of twelve are still playing for an opportunity to move on. After losing in sub-state the Canton/Galva girls, Inman boys, and Smoky Valley girls are done for the 2025/26 season.

item.title: Bullpups close season with 2 wins
item.description: After an unusual slow start to the 2025/26 season going 2-5 in December, the McPherson High boys basketball program seems to have straightened the ship out as they finished the regular season schedule going 6-2 in both January and February, including a pair of wins over Mulvane, 68-46, on Tuesday, followed by a road win at Winfield, 60-52, on Friday. item.description: The national title game between Miami and Indiana will be remembered not just for the final score, but for what it represents. Indiana, a program long respected for basketball stands as the national champion for the first time in history.
